source_facts.introduction: Our purpose is to understand how soil conditions influence nitrogen retention in urban wetlands.
source_facts.design: Water chemistry observations at six urban wetlands informed a process model. Two questions concern differences in retention among sites and whether the model describes changes between wet and dry periods.
source_facts.scope: The sites are a demonstration in one metropolitan region, not a representative sample of all urban wetlands.

cases.paragraph: We first sampled six urban wetlands in the metropolitan region. We then developed a process model. We then compared differences between sites between wet and dry periods. This study compared observations with model outputs.

source_facts.purpose: Understand whether urban tree cover moderates summer street temperatures.
source_facts.work: Relate canopy observations to street temperature records from 12 neighborhoods over two summers.
